description: This Java class defines a REST controller for managing email attachments, including uploading, downloading, and listing attachments associated with emails. It handles HTTP requests, interacts with services and repositories, and manages security and response headers.

classes.name: AttachmentController
classes.description: REST controller for handling email attachment operations such as upload, download, and listing attachments.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on the authentication object.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading one or more files as attachments to a specified email for the authenticated user.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading an attachment by its ID, ensuring it belongs to the current user, and setting appropriate response headers.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all attachments associated with a specific email for the current user.
